contracts.name: MessageBridge
contracts.role: Sends messages to the other chain and delivers the ones that arrive, after it checks the proofs that link each one to a finalized header of the other chain.

contracts.name: TokenMediator
contracts.role: Moves tokens through the bridge: it locks a native token here and mints a bridged copy on the other chain, or burns a copy and unlocks the native token.

contracts.name: BeaconForkGate
contracts.role: Refuses new sends when the other chain has moved to a state layout that the proof program cannot read.

contracts.name: TokenFactory
contracts.role: Creates the bridged copy of a token the first time that token is sent here.

contracts.name: DeliveryRouter
contracts.role: Optional entry point for delivery: it wraps the native coin, delivers the message, pays a voluntary tip, unwraps, and has its RouterCaller make the follow-up call.

contracts.name: RouterCaller
contracts.role: Makes the follow-up call of a delivery for the router above, which created it and is the only account that may use it. It holds nothing, so the call cannot reach tokens that sit in the router.

contracts.name: ReceiptProofLib
contracts.role: Library that checks the receipt, transaction and log proofs of a message against a block.

contracts.name: OpeningProofLib
contracts.role: Library that checks the opening proof that releases tokens locked by a one-way deposit.

contracts.name: BeaconLayoutLib
contracts.role: Library that checks the beacon state layout rows (block roots, block hashes, historical summaries) that a message proof relies on.

contracts.name: MediatorPayloads
contracts.role: Library that encodes and decodes the token messages that the mediator sends across the bridge.

contracts.name: BeaconLightClient
contracts.role: Light client of the PulseChain testnet v4 beacon chain, kept on Sepolia. It stores finalized headers and accepts a new one only with a zero-knowledge proof.

contracts.name: SP1Verifier
contracts.role: Checks the Groth16 zero-knowledge proofs that the light clients accept (the vendored SP1 verifier, version 6.1.0).

contracts.name: TestToken tUSD
contracts.role: Test token zkb Test Dollar (tUSD, 6 decimals). Only the deployer can mint it.

contracts.name: TestToken tTKN
contracts.role: Test token zkb Test Token (tTKN, 18 decimals). Only the deployer can mint it.

contracts.name: FaucetToken tFAU
contracts.role: Test token zkb Faucet Token (tFAU, 18 decimals). Anyone can mint it, at most 1,000 a call.

contracts.name: WETH
contracts.role: Wrapped ether on Sepolia, which the delivery router wraps the native coin into. Not deployed by this project.
